And some say it is better to begin only "Atah chonenatanu," etc., and not begin "Atah chonen," etc.; and the Levush wrote to say both "Atah chonen," etc., and also "Atah chonenatanu" — except he wrote to say twice "v'chanenu me'itkha," etc., meaning "Atah chonen," etc., l'anos binah, etc., and "v'chanenu me'itkha," etc., "Atah chonenatanu," etc., until "umedubakim b'yiratkha," and "v'chanenu me'itkha," etc.; and the Bach brought his words and disagrees.
